title: Microsoft Dataverse: semantic data understanding for agents and Copilot
summary: Hold: Microsoft has deferred automatic enablement for existing environments, and the table and signal configuration instructions no longer match the documented experience. The briefing also omits a required security role and incorrectly leaves licensing and Dataverse security enforcement unresolved. The cited Learn pages opened successfully in this check.
